question:
Select the correct meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

Lucy’s conceited conduct with her colleagues has left her __high and dry__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"high and dry"** means being left in a difficult or helpless situation without support. (मुश्किल स्थिति में छोड़ देना)
 
 
• **Example: **After the company went bankrupt, the employees were left high and dry without any severance pay.
 
 
 
• **Helpless** refers to a state where one is unable to defend oneself or act without assistance. (बेबस)
 
 
• **Example: **The flood victims were helpless and had to wait for rescue teams to arrive.
